name: Typewise OG social card by Typewise Nova
description: A 1200×630 dark social card built almost entirely from negative space: a near-black canvas, a compact logo lockup in the top-left, and a two-line white headline filling the lower-left third. Two thin, glowing blue arcs sweep through the top-right and bottom-left corners, creating diagonal energy that frames the type without competing with it. Hierarchy is carried purely by scale — a ~40px wordmark against a ~95px headline — with one electric blue accent repeated in the logo badge and the luminous swooshes.
